items.title: 7-Zip Vulnerabilities Allows Remote Attackers to Execute Arbitrary Code
items.description: Two high-severity vulnerabilities have been discovered in the popular open-source file archiver, 7-Zip, which could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code. Identified as CVE-2025-11001 and CVE-2025-11002, the flaws affect all versions of the software prior to the latest release and require immediate patching. Flaw in Symbolic Link Processing The core of both vulnerabilities lies […]…
